title: Multimodal AI predicts nuclear grade and prognosis in clear cell renal carcinoma
summary: Using whole-slide images and CT from 729 patients in three cohorts, AI-extracted features were combined into a multimodal predictive signature, which reached AUCs of 0.95, 0.93 and 0.95 for ISUP grade and a hazard ratio of 2.542 for survival in an external cohort. The study is retrospective.
ai_technology: AI feature extraction from whole-slide images and CT with a multimodal signature

evidence.tested: ISUP grading and prognostic stratification across three cohorts and prognostic validation cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; effect on adjuvant therapy decisions not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AI extraction of morphological and textural features from pathology and CT images.
